name: decompose-codex
description: Interview-driven project decomposer for Codex. Turns a vague app idea into PRD, Architecture, File Tree, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and Tasks markdown artifacts via the host Codex conversation, with no separate API key required.

interface.shortDescription: Turn app ideas into build briefs for Codex
interface.longDescription: Project Decomposer runs a focused interview inside Codex, renders a PRD, architecture, file tree, assistant guidance, and task plan through the host conversation, then writes the canonical artifact set directly from the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Decompose this app idea into a build brief
